page.overview:
Who is Dorando?

Dorando is a playable character of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Rampaging Warrior Dorando, he works for Sadali as he is sure that Sadali will become powerful. He seeks to take Fennes's throne for himself.

Dorando is an MR-rarity unit of the Earth element whose main job is Viking, while his sub jobs are Monk and Gunner. He can equip the following items: Axe, Helm, Clothing, Accessory. His unit cost is 50.

His Master Ability increases his own Max HP by 25% and his Critical Hit Rate by 15. He has no limit burst.

His Trust Master Reward is the Slaughter Axe weapon which bestows HP +68, ATK +114, ACC +12 and Normal Attack (Blind) Granted.
